/**
 * @name Code injection via eval/exec in dateutil
 * @description Using eval or exec with untrusted input can lead to arbitrary code execution
 * @kind path-problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/code-injection
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-094
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.TaintTracking
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.RemoteFlowSources
import semmle.python.Concepts

module CodeInjectionConfig implements DataFlow::ConfigSig {
  predicate isSource(DataFlow::Node source) {
    source instanceof RemoteFlowSource
  }

  predicate isSink(DataFlow::Node sink) {
    sink = any(CodeExecution ce).getCode()
  }
}

module CodeInjectionFlow = TaintTracking::Global<CodeInjectionConfig>;
import CodeInjectionFlow::PathGraph

from CodeInjectionFlow::PathNode source, CodeInjectionFlow::PathNode sink
where CodeInjectionFlow::flowPath(source, sink)
select sink.getNode(), source, sink, "Code injection from $@.", source.getNode(), "user input"
findings.hypothesis: Code injection vulnerabilities through eval/exec with user-controlled input

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Potentially dangerous operations
 * @description Check for dangerous operations like eval, exec, pickle, etc.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/dangerous-operations
 * @tags security
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    // Code execution
    call = API::moduleImport("builtins").getMember(["eval", "exec", "compile"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("__builtin__").getMember(["eval", "exec", "compile"]).getACall() or
    
    // Unsafe deserialization
    call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("marshal").getMember(["load", "loads"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("yaml").getMember(["load", "unsafe_load"]).getACall() or
    
    // Command execution
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("system").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["call", "check_call", "check_output", "run", "Popen"]).getACall()
  )
select call, "Potentially dangerous operation that could be unsafe if used with untrusted input."
findings.hypothesis: Check for dangerous operations like eval, exec, pickle loads, etc. in the codebase

/**
 * @name Path traversal vulnerability
 * @description Untrusted input flowing into file operations can lead to path traversal attacks
 * @kind path-problem
 * @problem.severity high
 * @id py/path-traversal
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-022
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.TaintTracking
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.RemoteFlowSources
import semmle.python.Concepts
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

module PathTraversalConfig implements DataFlow::ConfigSig {
  predicate isSource(DataFlow::Node source) {
    source instanceof RemoteFlowSource
  }

  predicate isSink(DataFlow::Node sink) {
    exists(API::CallNode call |
      (
        // File opening operations
        call = API::moduleImport("builtins").getMember("open").getACall() or
        call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["open", "remove", "unlink", "rename", "mkdir", "rmdir"]).getACall() or
        call = API::moduleImport("os.path").getMember(["join", "exists", "isfile", "isdir"]).getACall() or
        call = API::moduleImport("shutil").getMember(["copy", "move", "rmtree"]).getACall() or
        call = API::moduleImport("tarfile").getMember("open").getACall()
      )
      and
      sink = call.getArg(0)
    )
  }
}

module PathTraversalFlow = TaintTracking::Global<PathTraversalConfig>;
import PathTraversalFlow::PathGraph

from PathTraversalFlow::PathNode source, PathTraversalFlow::PathNode sink
where PathTraversalFlow::flowPath(source, sink)
select sink.getNode(), source, sink, "Path traversal vulnerability from $@.", source.getNode(), "user input"
findings.hypothesis: Path traversal vulnerabilities in file operations where untrusted input flows into file paths
